name: Supplier disruption and operational decision
description: Industry-neutral template (synthetic, no customer data): a supplier delays a delivery; the impact is assessed, the alternatives are compared and an authorised response is selected. A short delay is accepted by the agent; costly expediting and any change of supplier go to a person; replacing an exclusive supplier is prohibited.

parameters.question: From how many days of delay is the impact on operations major?
parameters.why: Below it the agent may accept the delay on its own; from it on, a response that costs money is needed

parameters.question: From which cost must a person approve expediting a shipment?
parameters.why: Below it the agent may book the expedite itself; at or above it the decision waits for a human reviewer

parameters.question: Which role approves costly expediting and any change of supplier?
parameters.why: The reviews are addressed to a role that a named member must hold before a pilot

parameters.question: Which role handles disruptions day to day?
parameters.why: Only this role may select a response; the agent acts with it

parameters.question: Which system holds purchase orders and deliveries (for example an ERP)?
parameters.why: Responses act outside Autology: they need a tool, first simulated, then a sandbox of that system

items.name: Supplier
items.rationale: The brief speaks of a supplier whose delivery is late

items.name: Delivery
items.rationale: The delayed delivery is what is assessed and decided on

value.description: A delivery expected from a supplier that is late

items.name: Alternative
items.rationale: The brief asks to compare available alternatives

value.description: Another source that could cover the delivery

items.rationale: A supplier is responsible for its deliveries
An alternative source is evaluated for a delivery

items.name: assess_impact
items.rationale: The operational impact is evaluated before any response

value.description: Evaluate the operational impact of the delay

items.name: compare_alternatives
items.rationale: The available alternatives are compared before a response is selected

value.description: Compare the alternatives: wait, expedite, or another source

items.name: accept_delay
items.rationale: A delay below the threshold has a minor impact: it is accepted and planning is told

value.description: Accept the delay and inform planning

items.name: switch_supplier
items.rationale: A major delay is answered from another source when one is available

value.description: Place the order with the alternative source

items.name: expedite_shipment
items.rationale: A major delay with no other source is answered by expediting the shipment

value.description: Book an expedited shipment with the supplier

items.rationale: Costly expediting is a person's decision

value.description: A {approver_role} approves expediting that costs {expedite_approval_cost} or more

items.rationale: Changing supplier always needs a person

value.description: A {approver_role} approves every change of supplier

items.rationale: An exclusive supplier may not be replaced, whoever asks

value.description: A supplier under an exclusivity agreement is never replaced

items.rationale: Only the planning role selects a response that costs money
Only the planning role changes supplier
The cost decides who approves, so it has a named writer

value.description: Only a {approver_role} changes the cost of expediting
An authorised response to the delayed delivery was selected and recorded

items.name: delivery_case
items.rationale: A run reads a delayed delivery with its supplier and its alternative from the records

value.description: A delayed delivery with its supplier and the alternative source

roles.name: {planner_role}
roles.description: Handles disruptions; the agent acts with this role

roles.name: {approver_role}
roles.description: Reviewer role: approves expediting of {expedite_approval_cost} or more and every change of supplier; maintains the expedite cost

agents.name: disruption_agent
agents.description: Takes a delayed delivery to an authorised response; stops for a person where the rules ask for one

Places the order with another source; simulated first
Updates the expected date; simulated first

The cost of expediting is known when the response is selected
unknowns: How production schedules depend on each item

Select a response the policy authorises, or ask the person the policy names
